FN-6YBU5ZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 465
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Leigh Hulsey
Security
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/23/2026
House Bill 465 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department
of Revenue by a minimal undetermined amount for the production and distribution of distinctive
license plate decals to individuals diagnosed with invisible disabilities and to the primary
caregivers of those individuals upon payment of the regular fees required by law for license
plates.
